payload.rebuttal: fixed: The docstring on _apply still said the fold passes no run_id and falls back to _run_for. After this change fold_task always resolves a concrete run_id itself, through _own_run_for or _run_for, before calling _apply, so that fallback is never taken by the fold. Reworded the docstring to say run_id is either a live writer's own run or one fold_task already resolved.
